comments.text:
50% of 6 year olds are studying for exam?!? Jesus what's next? Studying while in the womb?
Edit: 6 yo not 2 yo
Korea fit two dystopias on one peninsula.
Studying 12 hours a day for 20 years just to be replaced by AI. Brutal

Imagine everyone at a theater is sitting. Everyone can see.
One person stands. They get a better view.
The people behind them now can't see as well, so they stand too.
Eventually everyone is standing.
The relative advantage disappears, but everyone is less comfortable than before.
7:31 this mirrors what my Korean coworker told me about his culture: "parents don't care about you being exceptional for your own sake, they care about you being better than the neighbor's kid".
Perhaps the issue is not the education.  Perhaps the problem is that ONE TEST determines someones entire life.
Ironically, when you invest everything in competition you can lose sight of the ultimate prize which is life itself.

Im close to 40, and this still haunts me to this day. 
I could have been a C student and be in the same job. Instead i ruined my childhood for nothing in return. I make a average salary but worked twice as hard with no friends or social life

Syndrome said it perfectly "If everyone is super, no one is" 

So if everyone has a Masters, one is special.

This is why isekai fantasy anime are getting more and more popular in recent years. They are dreaming to live in a world where school doesn't exist and only 'education' they ever get are learning how to fight, cut down trees, taking care of livestock etc. from parents and other adults in the village. Physically demanding and high risk of injury but had lots of free time and almost stress-free, unlike modern education.
This is the problem of believing one could have a society comprised entirely of CEOs.

I work in schools in Toronto, which has a huge Asian population, and I see it firsthand: parents pushing kids into French immersion programs, arguing with teachers about their child's bad grades. The kid doesn't even speak English yet, but they're pushing for multiple languages.

And the neighborhood is littered with extra tutoring schools in plazas. All full till 6pm, I feel sorry for these kids.

The best part is, the goal of education is not even finding truth, sich as physcis, chemistry, biology, medicine... It is about existing within a society and be better than others... As how Asia feels inferior to the West, as the West is more relaxed so smart kids can actually pursue their interest and the truth they seek, and in long run winning the race

My wife is Chinese. Her friend in Shanghai has a daughter going into 6th grade. She’s spent the entire summer cramming for what she will learn in 6th grade. Why is she cramming for something she’s going to learn anyway? Because the rest of the students are and if she didn’t learn it too she would be “behind”.
It’s so disgusting to see people in these countries work each other to misery or death and then call anyone who doesn’t want to a degenerate.
“Mass shooters are getting paid more than star footballer.” I was like, WHAT?! Oh, maths tutors.
Main conclusion: both on a country level and personal level you SHOULD NOT GET STUCK TO THE OLD STEREOTYPE, rather to succeed you need to be FLEXIBLE!
